name: 1320 Fabrication
old_description: Welcome to our fabrication shop- where precision meets craftsmanship. From complete race car chassis service and modifications to custom roll cages and fabricated components, we do it all. Stop by our shop for everything your race car needs to win.
about:
1320 Fabrication operates from a shop at 170 Penrod Court in Glen Burnie, Maryland. The founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed, and no founders are named in available sources.

The shop specializes in custom metal fabrication for competition vehicles, with a focus on TIG welding of chromoly, stainless steel, aluminum, and titanium. Services include complete chassis work for hot rods, imports, bracket cars, dragsters, and promods; roll bars and cages built to SFI 25.1–25.5 specifications; mini tubs; stainless steel headers and exhaust systems; custom rear housings; suspension setup and scaling; fuel cell installation; turbo manifolds; intercoolers; carbon fiber components; Lexan windows; race jacks; and JR dragster builds.

Customers come primarily from the drag racing and hot rod segments, including bracket racers, professional drag teams, and JR dragster competitors. The company has a multi-year sponsorship relationship with Maryland International Raceway’s ET Series and was named the 2026 Super Street Series title sponsor for the Professional Drag Racers Association (PDRA).

The company emphasizes precision and craftsmanship in its fabrication work, but does not publish a formal statement on why it was founded or what specifically differentiates it from other race shops.
